status: ambient-surjectivity conjecture refuted; exact hiding remains open on the legal image

classification.established: The currently accepted distinct secure Frobenius-conjugate OOD pair makes every M31-component two-point OOD view a four-dimensional Frobenius graph, so the existing raw-C1 ambient rank target 108 is unattainable and the measured rank is 104.
classification.not_established: This is not a zero-knowledge counterexample: the honest witness view and mask view obey the same Frobenius relation. Exact hiding requires image containment on the legal same-statement witness-difference image, not surjectivity onto the ambient serialized-coordinate product.

frobenius_orbit.conditioning: Given one uniformly sampled secure QM31 parameter, the second accepted distinct parameter is uniform on the remaining P^4-P^2-1 secure parameters. Exactly its three other Frobenius-orbit elements produce a nontrivial conjugate pair. The excluded CM31 subfield already contains the singular +/-i roots rejected by the circle parameter map.
frobenius_orbit.consequence: The bad pair is rare but legal. A universal exact-hiding theorem must cover it, or the sampler must add an explicitly analysed orbit rejection rule.
